Tafsir al-Jalalayn on surah 102, verse 1:

﴿Distracted you﴾ (ألهاكم) kept you occupied (شغلكم) away from obedience to Allah ﴿from competing in acquisition﴾ (التكاثر) boasting about wealth, children and men.

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 102, verse 2:

﴿Until you visit the graves﴾ by dying and being buried in them, or by counting the dead out of rivalry in numbers.

Let me translate this passage from Tafsir al-Jalalayn on Surah al-Takathur (102:3).

Note: The passage contains the verse fragment ﴿كَلّا﴾ and the commentary words "رَدْع" and the verse fragment ﴿سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾.

﴿Nay!﴾ A rebuke. ﴿You will come to know.﴾

Quranic verse: ﴿Then no! You are going to know.﴾

Commentary: "You will come to know the evil consequence of your boasting, at the moment of death, and then in the grave."
﴿Nay﴾, truly, ﴿if you knew with the knowledge of certainty﴾, a certain knowledge, of the consequence of boasting, [and] of what you were occupied with.

﴿لَتَرَوُنَّ الجَحِيم﴾ (*La-tarawunna al-jahim*): **al-Jahim** is **the Fire** (*al-nar*). The **lam** of the oath (*jawab qasam*, the answer to an implied oath) is answered here. The oath itself is omitted. From the verb **ترون** the **lam** (last radical) and the **'ayn** (middle radical) of the root are dropped, and its vowel (*harakah*) is transferred to the **ra'** (ر).

Translation:

﴿Then you will surely see it﴾: emphasis (ta'kid). ﴿With the certainty of sight﴾ ('ayn al-yaqin): a verbal noun (masdar), because ra'a (to see) and 'ayana (to witness with one's own eyes) have the same meaning.

Then you will surely be asked on that Day about the delight (al-Na'im).

The nun of the plural (nun al-raf') has been deleted from ﴿لَتُسْأَلُنَّ﴾ because of the succession of the two nuns, and the waw of the plural pronoun has been deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters (iltiqa' al-sakinayn). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ means the Day of seeing it (Hell). ﴿عَنِ النَّعِيمِ﴾ means whatever one takes pleasure in during the world, such as good health, leisure, food, drink and other things.
